name: Agent build

steps.name: AgentSpec: purpose, inputs, outputs, forbidden actions, escalation
Does it fit behind the agent port, or does the port change
steps.note: a design decision puts Jido behind a port precisely so the domain does not learn about Jido. A port change is an ADR.

steps.name: What context it gets, and what it must not see
What it remembers and for how long
Implement under supervision, with stated failure semantics
Run it in a sandbox against its failure suite
Baseline it before it becomes the default

trigger.note: The bare keyword `agent` was removed. This workflow's intent says "one of the Jido agents behind the agent port", and in this repository the commoner sense of the word is the other one: `.agents/` is a registry of 270 coding roles and every harness bead says `agent` several times. "Dependency-authored agent instructions" routed here, to a workflow about runtime agents with permissions and memory. Verified before and after against `Add a new agent for the agent gateway` and `Add an agent that narrates transitions`, which route here either way.
